title: New England Patriots vs. Buffalo Bills Postgame Analysis: What Happened, What We Got Right and What We Learned
seo_title: New England Patriots 29-26 Buffalo Bills: EdgeDesk Postgame Thesis Audit
excerpt: New England Patriots won 29-26. The number did not land and the reasoning half held. There is something here to investigate without concluding the model is broken.
seo_description: New England Patriots beat Buffalo Bills 29-26. EdgeDesk’s number implied Buffalo Bills -6.5 — loss. 0 of 11 gradeable claims held up, 4 did not. Process grade: MIXED. Research, not picks.
model_status_note: The number did not land and the reasoning half held. There is something here to investigate without concluding the model is broken.
author: EdgeDesk Research
research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 49 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. Projection: the same edgedesk_football_v1.0.0 call the game card makes. Nothing on this page was computed in your browser twice.
